tasks.label: Health: GET /api/health
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "try{ Invoke-RestMethod -Method GET -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/health' -TimeoutSec 10 | Format-List * } catch { Write-Error $_ }"

tasks.label: TTS Smoke: POST /api/v1/tts-with-timing
tasks.command: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$b=@{text='مرحباً! هذا اختبار للمنظومة.';voice='ar-SA-HamedNeural';language='ar-SA';format='wav';sample_rate=24000;with_timing=$true} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 -Compress; $r=Invoke-RestMethod -Method POST -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1/tts-with-timing' -ContentType 'application/json; charset=utf-8' -Body $b -TimeoutSec 25; $r | Select-Object format,sample_rate,timing_mode,provider | Format-List; if ($r.audio_wav_base64){[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes('tts.wav',[Convert]::FromBase64String($r.audio_wav_base64)); 'Saved tts.wav'} elseif ($r.audio_mp3_base64){[IO.File]::WriteAllBytes('tts.mp3',[Convert]::FromBase64String($r.audio_mp3_base64)); 'Saved tts.mp3'}"

tasks.label: Stack: Up → Health → TTS → Open UI
